worldcombat.skill.crushgrip.summary: A huge force-hand closes from both sides around the target: attack and weight set the grip, and the more HP the target still has, the heavier the crush. It is the heaviest, slowest and most expensive of the three pressing moves and the only one that moves the target - the hoist form lifts the foe, holds it, then slams it back down for a fixed extra hit and a short root, while the stay form simply crushes once.
Crush Grip deals %1$s Normal contact damage; the more HP the target still has, the heavier the crush.
You can reach %1$s blocks; the grip closes around the target at a %2$s block radius and throws about %3$s chips.
worldcombat.skill.crushgrip.hoist.on: Hoist form: after the grip, the target is lifted at %1$s blocks/tick and held %2$s ticks, then slammed down at %3$s blocks/tick for a %4$s-power hit and rooted for %5$s ticks; the first grip is x0.9, wind-up +4 ticks, recovery +4 ticks and cooldown +8 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.crushgrip.hoist.off: Stay form (default): one grip, heavier and quicker, without moving the target.
worldcombat.skill.crushgrip.timing: Wind-up %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cost %3$s PP, cooldown %4$s s.
worldcombat.skill.crushgrip.growth.0: From level %1$s: grip power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.crushgrip.growth.1: From level %1$s: grip power rises to %2$s and the grip radius widens to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.crushgrip.use.0: Crush a full-HP target's bar with the heaviest grip
worldcombat.skill.crushgrip.use.1: Lift, hold and slam a key target with the hoist form
worldcombat.skill.crushgrip.use.2: Break up a target's position by moving it
worldcombat.skill.crushgrip.preference.h: On: after the grip, lift the target, hold it, then slam it back down for a fixed extra hit and a short root; the first grip is x0.9, wind-up +4 ticks, recovery +4 ticks, cooldown +8 ticks. Off: stay form, one grip, heavier and quicker.
worldcombat.skill.crushgrip.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in before gripping. Larger values reach from further out and get walked away from while the palm shadows form more often.
On: sort targets by remaining HP fraction, full-HP foes first (the grip is heaviest on them). Off: only the threat itself counts, so it will grip wounded foes too.
